reviews.text: They're really good with my dog and I usually manage to get same day appointment as well, which I really appreciate.
Great staff, my cat actually loves them.
As usual, Dr. Miriam is exceptional and empathetic. Always a pleasure seeing her and Dr. Michael.
Thank you for the 5 stars Alex 🐾 …

The care provided to pets and owners at this practice is excellent. Health promotion, health care and end of life care are consistently excellent. The care is matched by professionalism and compassion. We have had beloved dogs for over 30 years in different countries and this practice stands out from the others in every respect.
Nice kind staff and caring for animals.
Extremely nice, and great service
Very friendly, efficient and professional

Our retriever puppy got herself into a risky situation after ingesting something that could have been life-threatening.
We’re deeply thankful to Michael and John for their incredible care, calm professionalism, and genuine empathy throughout the ordeal.
They went above and beyond to make sure she was okay.
We couldn’t have asked for better people to look after her.
All the best from Río who is making a great recovery already 🐾

A really excellent veterinary practice! The level of care they give to their patients is amazing and the staff are all incredibly helpful. They give great advice and are really transparent about the procedures and pricing. Would recommend without hesitation!
Hi Naomi, Thanks so much for leaving us a review.  Much appreciated.
Thanks so much for taking the time to leave us a review Daniel.
The only vets I trust with my spoiled dog

Gabrielle Foy's behavior was very rude to me and my dog. She didn't even say hello to us. When my dog ​​wanted to kiss her she pushed him away with her hand and her facial expression was horrible. She was not friendly at all. We will never go to Sandymount Vet clinic again.
Orla explained what the dog problem was.
Super spot, filled with caring staff. Highly recommend visiting them with your pet.
Top class service as always from Orla. Thank you.
Many Thanks Tara.
Thanks for the 5 stars Guillermo - I hope Skala feels the same!
Excellent pet healthcare.
John is the best. Our dog needed two TPLO surgeries and bith times John did a fantastic job. Our dog is running and playing as if nothing happend. I highly recommend Sandymount Vet.
Very kind vets and staff. Thank you!

What a great experience from scheduling, the visit and leaving… I was able to get an appointment within days, which us so rare and upon entering they treated our “Brisket” (Boxer) so well and like family. This relaxed him and he took his vaccines like a champ!! Phenomenal staff and extremely caring doctors!!
Great service and the vets really demonstrate obvious care for their animal patients!

Terrible experience I brought my dog in after eating a seagull on sandymount she is 1years old and was visible chocking and her belly was swollen. UCD emergency vets was closed so they referred us to sandymount vets as they were the emergency vets on today. After dropping my dog in they rang me 8 minutes later to say we should bring her to another vet as we complained a few years ago when they killed our 3 year old pup they would not help us and returned her to me 8 minutes later while she is still visible gasping for air.  Shame on you all !

Disgraceful business. Brought my dog to her today in an emergency and they said she needs an operation but they don’t want to do it.
We lost one dog 2 years ago in theatre with this vet and they refused to take another dog who needed an emergency treatment.
Our cat was undiagnosed and suffering for a long time until we found Dr John Hanley at Sandymount vets. He was so professional and knowledgeable and we appreciated his care very much.
The best vet around. Especially Orla & Miriam who always treat our dog like a person. They put you at ease on each visit. Wouldn’t go anywhere else.
